subject: Connexa - Private deployment kickstart and scheduling
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@connexahealth.com>, Mike Lee <mike.lee@connexahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Connexa - Private deployment kickstart and scheduling

Hi Aisha / Mike —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a focused architecture review on the calendar: 

Recap (very short):
- Primary goal: production-grade private/VPC deployment for PHI workloads, low-latency inference inside Connexa network.
- Constraints called out: SOC 2 controls, inbound-only peering for audit, 3-year retention for audit logs (Connexa requirement).
- Short-term priority: validate network topology and KMS integration for key management.

Proposed next step: a 60–75 minute technical architecture review (Redwood SE + Connexa infra + security) to walk through: network design options (VPC peering vs. private link), KMS/HSM options, audit/logging, and deployment footprint sizing. 

I can run through available slots — please pick any that work or suggest alternatives: 
- Tue Nov 24, 2026 — 10:00–11:15 AM PST / 1:00–2:15 PM EST
- Wed Nov 25, 2026 — 1:00–2:15 PM PST / 4:00–5:15 PM EST
- Thu Nov 26, 2026 — 8:30–9:45 AM PST / 11:30–12:45 PM EST

Who from Connexa should attend? (I suggest: infra lead, security/compliance, and the product owner.) We’ll bring Monica (SE) and myself; Sergio will join for the first 30 mins to orient.

Attached: a short "Connexa-MVP-reqs.pdf" and our "private-deploy-architecture-template.docx" — please drop any existing network diagrams into the Drive link below if you want us to review them ahead of time.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aconnexa_shared/architecture-kickstart
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/4821

Would love to lock a slot — happy to adapt to your schedule.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

We’re keen to move forward. Confirming our core attendees will be: Mike Lee (Infra Lead), Priya Shah (Security, SOC2 lead - she’s out this week but will dial in for the important bits), and myself (product).

Of the proposed slots the best for us is: Wed Nov 25, 2026 — 4:00–5:15 PM EST (your Wed 1:00–2:15 PM PST). That works for Mike as well.

- We’ll share our current network diagram (Mike will upload to your Drive link by EOD Monday).
